about: Mount commands discover specs at parse time. Their stdout is injected by exact run string so the grammar does not depend on a shell, executable, filesystem, or host platform.

vectors.doc: An unknown command name triggers the root mount and is re-examined against the commands it contributes.
A mount on a selected command contributes its children at that command rather than at the root.
A root mount that does not opt into overriding the default cannot claim an unmatched word from that default.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
default_subcommand "run"
mount run="discover commands"
cmd "run" {
  arg "<task>"
}

vectors.doc: A root mount with overrides_default may discover a command before the default consumes its name.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
default_subcommand "run"
mount run="discover commands" overrides_default=#true
cmd "run" {
  arg "<task>"
}

vectors.doc: After crossing a mount boundary, the mounted command's local spelling owns a name that also belongs to the mounting CLI's global flag.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
flag "--env <root-env>" global=#true
mount run="discover task"

vectors.doc: Flags on the mounted spec's root are accepted at the command holding the mount, alongside its discovered children.
